title: Mechanistic Insights into T-2 Toxin-Induced Thymic Epithelial Cell Injury and Immunotoxicity via the ROS-NF-kappaB-NLRP3 Signaling Axis.
authors: Zhang, Yanfang; Chen, Mingyan; Niu, Ruiyan; Guo, Dongguang; Sun, Zilong
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究T-2毒素通过ROS-NF-kappaB-NLRP3信号轴诱导胸腺上皮细胞损伤的免疫毒性机制，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Thymic epithelial cells (TECs) are critical for thymic structure and function, yet the impact of T-2 toxin (T-2) on TECs and related molecular pathways remains unclear. This study sheds light on the mechanisms of T-2-induced TEC damage, focusing on the ROS-NF-kappaB-NLRP3 signaling axis. The in vivo and in vitro analyses suggest that T-2 induces TEC injury through ROS-driven NLRP3 inflammasome activation, NF-kappaB signaling, inflammation, and apoptosis. Molecular docking analysis verified the binding of T-2 to critical components involved in oxidative stress, inflammatory signaling pathways, and apoptosis. These findings were further supported by therapeutic interventions targeting ROS and NLRP3. N-acetylcysteine (NAC) effectively reduced ROS levels, suppressed NF-kappaB signaling, inhibited NLRP3 activation, and mitigated inflammation and apoptosis, effects mirrored by the NLRP3 inhibitor MCC950, emphasizing the critical role of ROS-mediated NLRP3 inflammasome activation through NF-kappaB signaling in T-2-induced TEC damage. Concurrently, inhibition of the NF-kappaB signaling further suppressed ROS levels, NLRP3 inflammasome activation, and apoptosis in MTEC1 cells, emphasizing the pivotal function of the ROS-NF-kappaB-NLRP3 axis in the pathogenesis of T-2-induced thymic injury. Our study offers an in-depth insight into the mechanisms driving T-2-induced immunotoxicity and identifies potential therapeutic strategies targeting these pathways to mitigate thymic injury and preserve immune function.
abstract_zh: 胸腺上皮细胞（TECs）对胸腺结构和功能至关重要，然而T-2毒素（T-2）对TECs的影响及相关分子通路仍不清楚。本研究揭示了T-2诱导TEC损伤的机制，重点关注ROS-NF-kappaB-NLRP3信号轴。体内和体外分析表明，T-2通过ROS驱动的NLRP3炎症小体激活、NF-kappaB信号传导、炎症和凋亡诱导TEC损伤。分子对接分析验证了T-2与氧化应激、炎症信号通路和凋亡中关键组分的结合。这些发现进一步得到针对ROS和NLRP3的治疗干预支持。N-乙酰半胱氨酸（NAC）有效降低ROS水平，抑制NF-kappaB信号传导，抑制NLRP3激活，并减轻炎症和凋亡，这些效应与NLRP3抑制剂MCC950的作用相似，强调了ROS介导的NLRP3炎症小体通过NF-kappaB信号激活在T-2诱导TEC损伤中的关键作用。同时，抑制NF-kappaB信号进一步抑制了MTEC1细胞中的ROS水平、NLRP3炎症小体激活和凋亡，凸显了ROS-NF-kappaB-NLRP3轴在T-2诱导胸腺损伤发病机制中的核心功能。我们的研究深入揭示了T-2诱导免疫毒性的机制，并确定了针对这些通路的潜在治疗策略，以减轻胸腺损伤并保护免疫功能。
